title: The Chow ring of $\mathcal{S}_5^-$ is tautological
summary: The moduli spaces $\mathcal{S}_g^-$ parametrise odd spin curves of genus $g$. These are pairs $[C, η]$ where $C$ is a smooth genus $g$ curve of and $η$ is a line bundle on $C$ such that $η^{\otimes 2} = ω_C$ and $h^0(C, η)$ is odd. The main result of this work is the tautology of the Chow ring of $\mathcal{S}_5^-$. Our method of proof revolves around an analysis of the geometry of canonical genus 5 curves and totally tangent hyperplanes.
